🌴 Welcome to Vhojon Roshik!

In today's exciting travel and food vlog, we explore the beautiful Jungle Bari Resort located in Purbachal, Bangladesh. If you're searching for a budget-friendly resort near Dhaka, then this video is for you!

We visited Jungle Bari Resort and experienced its peaceful natural environment, green surroundings, delicious food, relaxing atmosphere, and affordable facilities. Surprisingly, this resort tour can be enjoyed with a very low entry cost, making it one of the most interesting budget travel destinations around Dhaka.

In this video, you'll see:
✅ Jungle Bari Resort full tour
✅ Resort environment and facilities
✅ Food review and taste experience
✅ Budget travel guide
✅ Purbachal tourist attraction
✅ Family-friendly resort experience
✅ Beautiful natural scenery
✅ Travel tips and honest review

Whether you are planning a family outing, friends gathering, weekend trip, picnic, food tour, or short vacation near Dhaka, Jungle Bari Resort can be a great destination.
